item.description: Caroline (Caroline Bouvier Kennedy) was born on November 27, 1957, and just about to turn 3 years old when John F. Kennedy was elected on November 8, 1960.

item.title: How old was Stan Lee when he created Spider-Man? - Answers
item.description: Spider-Man made his first appearance in Marvel Comics in August 1962. Stan Lee was born on December 28, 1922. That means he was 39 when he and artist Steve Ditko created Spider-Man.
